chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Rifa'ah and Hafs, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who vowed to walk to the House of God barefoot. He said, 'Let him walk, but when he becomes weary, let him ride.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone vows to walk to the Kaaba barefoot but gets tired?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of *raf' al-haraj* (removal of hardship) within the jurisprudence of vows (*fiqh al-nudhur*). By permitting the transition from walking to riding upon fatigue, the Imam demonstrates that the spirit of the vow is preserved through sincere effort rather than rigid adherence to a specific mode of travel that might lead to excessive burden.
